name: P1106: the firmware is never written (test_flow.TheFirmwareWrittenTest.test_each_partial_deploy_but_a_lost_board_says_the_firmware_is_written)
find: if unseen and station["place"] == flow_codes.DONE_PLACE and station["phase"] == flow_codes.FIRMWARE else station

name: P1106: every done firmware is written (test_flow.TheFirmwareWrittenTest.test_every_other_deploy_keeps_a_plain_firmware)
find: if unseen and station["place"] == flow_codes.DONE_PLACE and station["phase"] == flow_codes.FIRMWARE else station
replace: if station["place"] == flow_codes.DONE_PLACE and station["phase"] == flow_codes.FIRMWARE else station

name: P1106: the firmware is written at and after now too (test_flow.TheStationsTest.test_the_firmware_before_now_is_written_when_the_start_was_not_seen_and_no_other_phase_is)
find: if unseen and station["place"] == flow_codes.DONE_PLACE and station["phase"] == flow_codes.FIRMWARE else station
replace: if unseen and station["phase"] == flow_codes.FIRMWARE else station

name: P1106: a lost board after ready is written too (test_flow.TheFirmwareWrittenTest.test_every_other_deploy_keeps_a_plain_firmware)
find: return state.status == flow_codes.PARTIAL and not lost_after_ready(state.logged)

name: P1106: ready not seen is written too (test_flow.TheFirmwareWrittenTest.test_every_other_deploy_keeps_a_plain_firmware)
find: return state.status == flow_codes.PARTIAL and not lost_after_ready(state.logged)
replace: return state.status in (flow_codes.PARTIAL, PROBLEMS) and not lost_after_ready(state.logged)
